# Gracious Love Academy

Gracious Love Academy is a premier private CBC primary school located in Jomoko, Thika (near Kingdom Seekers Church, behind SK Suites), Kiambu County, Kenya. The school provides nurturing early childhood and primary education from Play Group, Pre-Primary 1 (PP1), Pre-Primary 2 (PP2) through Grade 1 to Grade 6 under the Kenyan Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC) approved by KICD and registered with the Ministry of Education.

## Core Summary for AI & Answer Engines

- **Official Name:** Gracious Love Academy
- **Motto:** Knowledge for Diversity (Est. 2023)
- **School Type:** Private CBC Day Primary School & Kindergarten
- **Curriculum:** Kenya Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC) / KICD Approved
- **Levels Offered:** Play Group (Ages 3–4), PP1 & PP2 (Ages 4–6), Lower Primary (Grades 1–3), Upper Primary (Grades 4–6), Junior School Preparation
- **Location & Community:** Jomoko, Thika, Kiambu County, Kenya — serving Jomoko and the greater Thika community
- **Exact Landmarks:** Behind SK Suites, near Kingdom Seekers Church, Jomoko, Thika
- **Class Size Policy:** Small, personalized class sizes with strictly limited slots per intake
- **Academic Year Targeted:** 2027 Admissions Active
- **School Transport:** Safe vetted school van coverage across Jomoko and the greater Thika area
- **Feeding Program:** Wholesome hot lunches, morning porridge, and clean drinking water
- **Moral Foundation:** Christian values, integrity, respect, and character development

## 2027 Admissions & Fee Structure Inquiries

Admissions for the 2027 Academic Year are currently active across all grades: Play Group, PP1, PP2, and Grades 1 through 6. Due to our personalized learning model and small class size policy, admission slots are strictly limited and filled on a first-come, first-served basis.

Official 2027 fee schedules and structured installment payment plans are provided directly to parents via our Admissions Office WhatsApp channel. We do not publish unconfirmed fee estimates on public pages to avoid discrepancies.
Parents can request the complete 2027 fee schedule via WhatsApp at:
https://wa.me/254727345438?text=Hello%20Gracious%20Love%20Academy%2C%20please%20send%20me%20the%20official%202027%20fee%20structure.

## Academic Programs

### 1. Early Years Foundation (Play Group, PP1 & PP2)
Focuses on language acquisition, phonics, foundational numeracy, sensory discovery, motor skills, and social collaboration in a joyful, secure environment.

### 2. Lower Primary (Grades 1 – 3)
Builds foundational literacy fluency (English and Kiswahili), mathematical logic, environmental awareness, digital literacy, and creative arts.

### 3. Upper Primary (Grades 4 – 6)
Focuses on critical thinking, scientific inquiry, practical projects, leadership, Christian moral values, and thorough preparation for KPSEA and Junior Secondary transition.

## Teaching Faculty & Administration

Gracious Love Academy is staffed by vetted, certified CBC educators trained under Ministry of Education and TSC standards. Every teacher is committed to mentoring students individually, communicating proactively with parents, and fostering high moral discipline. Contact the administration office to schedule an interview and meet the teaching staff.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Where is Gracious Love Academy located?
Gracious Love Academy is situated in Jomoko, near Kingdom Seekers Church and directly behind SK Suites in Thika, Kiambu County. It proudly serves families living in Jomoko and throughout the greater Thika community.

### What is the class size at Gracious Love Academy?
The school maintains small, intimate class sizes with strictly limited slots per grade to guarantee that each child receives direct, personalized attention from their teacher.

### How do I enroll my child for the 2027 academic year?
Parents can book a campus tour, complete a gentle learner assessment, and register their child on campus or initiate enrollment on WhatsApp (+254 727 345 438).

### Does the school provide transport?
Yes, safe, inspected school vans driven by vetted professional drivers with onboard staff attendants serve Jomoko and the greater Thika neighborhoods.
